title: Explainable deep learning for predicting temperature breaks and identifying their causal drivers in fresh produce cold chains.
summary: Two IoT datasets from South African apple cold storage, eight ML models and three baselines; LSTM-GRU best recurrent model, DNN performance improved with extended differing conditions, fewer false alarms/day, all DNNs flagged breaks in advance; LPCMCI identified lagged temperature as dominant. Authors note few recovered causal links and unmeasured drivers. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
